column3: “Impossible” renders wonderful; these days replaces those days.
“West” condenses the entrance of the sun.
“Faithful and righteous God” turns in faithfulness and righteousness into adjectives qualifying God.
“Were present” supplies a verb for the prophets on the day of founding.
“Therefore” replaces and before the command to love.
The residents of cities are placed in apposition to peoples instead of being joined with and.
The two acts of taking hold are condensed, and robe replaces the skirt of the garment.
